name: trycatch_handler_completion
description: Complete the condition handlers of an existing tryCatch / withCallingHandlers call (proposals_v1 rank 5, the CORRECTED suffix-convention version - completion, never wrapping). The cursor sits right after the comma following the guarded expression block; the completion is the author's handler clauses verbatim through the call's closing paren (tier-1 exact gate in handler_cut_cursor; tree-sitter structural floor in handler_clauses: named handlers error/warning/message/finally, the first three one-formal functions).
novelty_note: Fills the named error-handling gap; nothing existing emits condition-handling code. Deliberately completion-NOT-wrapping (gemini#9 corrected): wrapping would re-indent the file below the cursor - the retired whole-region convention. Handler clauses are capped at max_handler_lines=4 for wave 1 (the canonical one-handler shape: header, up to two body lines, closing paren; keeps the exact gate learnable); the multi-valid-target caveat is acknowledged and eval must report structural-pass separately from exact.
